title: Top 10 with dumbbells
description: One pair of adjustable dumbbells is enough for a full program. These give the most for the least equipment.

exercises.why: Easiest way to load a squat with one dumbbell.
Hamstrings and glutes; teaches the hip hinge.
Chest and triceps pressing without a bench.
Builds the upper back and lats.
Shoulders and triceps; also trains the trunk.
Strong single-leg work with simple setup.
Best home exercise for glutes (use a sofa).
Long head of the triceps with one dumbbell.
Side delts for shoulder width; light weights are enough.
